newsitem.title: USA: Worldwide Broadcasting sets Internet news service.
newsitem.headline: Worldwide Broadcasting sets Internet news service.

text.p: Worldwide Broadcasting Network Monday said it will launch its new subscription-based Internet news and information service in January, 1997.
WBN, throught BBN Planet, its technology partner and Internet service provider, will narrowcast customized, interactive multimedia content to desktop PCs via the Internet to company intranets.
BBN Planet is a unit of BBN Corp.
WBN programming will incorporate high quality video and audio coupled with text, graphics and interactive features such as message boards, chat groups, collaboration and application sharing.
In addition, WBN will offer programs produced and developed in partnership with corporate users and independent producers.
